blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: unit testing — Test one module/function in isolation.
integration testing — Check interaction of components.
system testing — Test the entire application as a system.
acceptance testing — Check fitness for user/business requirements.
regression testing — Repeat tests to catch defects after changes.

blocks.title: Test individual units
blocks.text: Unit tests isolate one function or class method from the rest of the system.

blocks.title: Test connections and behaviour
blocks.text: Integration tests interactions between modules; system tests the complete application.

blocks.title: Confirm intended outcome
blocks.text: Acceptance testing checks whether the delivered application meets stakeholder requirements. Automated regression tests rerun after changes.
